verdict.rationale: Persona is fundamentally an API-first platform that can be operated fully headlessly, and it provides explicit integration-testing tooling (Simulate Actions, sandbox mode with force pass/fail toggles) designed to programmatically test inquiry/verification behavior without a UI, plus webhooks and workflows for automation-driven triggering — all strong signals for CI-style automation. However, there's no explicit CI/CD documentation, pipeline examples, or third-party confirmation of running it inside a CI system. Missing for 10: explicit CI/CD integration guides or examples, independent/hands-on confirmation of headless automation in a CI pipeline.
